messages:
sara: Heads-up: ResellWorks says a set of GCP Marketplace refunds we issued on Mar 12 were applied to their partner settlement but not to downstream customer invoices. They see a positive balance but downstreams still billed.

mike-fin: Do we have sample transaction IDs? need to identify which invoices to credit.

sara: Sample from their report:
```
RefundTx,OriginalInvoice,PartnerAccount,DownstreamId,Amount
r-842,inv-20260312-RW,resellworks-gcp-101,rw-cust-55,120.00
```
They claim our settlement report shows r-842 applied to partner netting only.

olivia-ops: Checked the settlement pipeline logs. Refund routing step applied partner-level settlement adjustments but the downstream_credit step failed with: `KeyError: downstream_id` for those rows.

eng-plat: Looks like schema drift in ResellWorks feed — they renamed `downstream_customer` -> `downstream_id` on 2026-03-12 and our downstream_credit job expects `downstream_customer`. Fallback didn't catch it.

mike-fin: Finance needs a reconciliation CSV to issue credits: columns: downstream_id, invoice_id, refund_amount, partner_ref, reason. We'll mark credits as "provisional - pending partner confirmation".

sara: ResellWorks uploaded mapping and confirmed they will resend a corrected refund file. They also approved a provisional settlement to cover the outstanding downstream credits.

eng-plat: Quick fix: I'll add a tolerant parser to downstream_credit job to accept both `downstream_customer` and `downstream_id` fields. Small patch, ETA 24hrs to deploy.

olivia-ops: Ingest validation: add a check to fail the partner feed if required downstream identifier is missing and create an automatic incident ticket.

billing-bot: audit: ticket-8342 created; resellworks_refunds_mar12.csv uploaded to /evidence/ticket-8342/ at 2026-03-24T10:22:05Z

mike-fin: Once eng deploys and we re-run the downstream_credit job, finance will generate the provisional credit memos and attach to BILL-8342. Leaving thread open until credits posted.

sara: Thanks all. Assigned follow-ups in BILL-8342 and tagging billing-bot to capture final evidence when done. :white_check_mark:
